The files of src/android/framework whose header names the Android Open Source Project follow its source in parts
(Apache-2.0, LICENSE.txt beside this file). These are the notices of the Android Open Source Project's NOTICE files
that pertain to them. Their other sections are for code ScarletNX does not carry.

The section for the Android-specific code, as frameworks/base/NOTICE and libcore/NOTICE both carry it
(https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/base/+/refs/heads/main/NOTICE):

Android Code
Copyright 2005-2008 The Android Open Source Project

This product includes software developed as part of
The Android Open Source Project (http://source.android.com).

The notice of Conscrypt (external/conscrypt/NOTICE), the source of android.net.ssl.SSLSockets:

Copyright 2016 The Android Open Source Project
